title: The Yearbook of Maple Street
author: Ines Blackwood
blurb: Zephyrine Galloway, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
